title: Grow
suits: climate, agritech, food, wellbeing, community and growth tools: products about something living, growing or being nurtured over time

params.--field: the sky; soil, grass, roots and dust are mixed from it
params.--brand: seed, stem and vines (pushed toward the ink if it would vanish on the field)
params.--rv-y: the ground line, which is the name's baseline
params.__MARK__: stroke paths in a 24 x 24 box; each stroke grows as a vine, dots pop like buds

details: the seed tumbles out of the sky with gravity and lands with a squash
a puff of dust skims the ground from the first landing only
it bounces once, then splits; the husk halves stay at the foot of the plant
a root goes down with two side roots while a short stem goes up
the mark's own strokes grow out of the stem as vines at one speed, both ways from where they start
closed shapes grow both ways round from their lowest point
pale growing tips lead every vine
a stroke that does not touch the rest is reached by a thin tendril that withers once it has grown
dots in the mark pop like buds as the nearest vine passes
leaves bud along the vines on the side away from the mark's centre
the first leaf opens underside-first and turns over
the last leaf keeps a dew drop that catches the light once
a runner creeps under the ground line, putting down rootlets, and each letter sprouts from the soil as it passes
letters spring up with a small wobble, alternating left and right
after the reveal the leaves sway in a slow draught
the soil is kept far enough from the ink that descenders stay readable
